company.name: Theorem
company.shortDescription: Theorem uses data science and machine learning to invest in marketplace lending loans, profitably managing over $800mm in assets.
company.description: Theorem uses machine learning, data science, and software engineering to invest in loans originated by online platforms.  Hugh Edmundson (CEO) is formerly a member of Morgan Stanley’s credit derivatives team, and Abeer Agrawal (CTO) is a former Googler and employee #1 at a startup called MobileSpan (which got acquired by Dropbox).  We started off with YC's winter 2014 batch, managing $50k in assets.  Today we are a company of almost 30 employees managing over $800 million AUM, and Theorem’s assets have increased by more than 50% since year-end 2017.
